maps = maps %>%

```{r}
#' Format flagged messages with temporal context for GPT input
#'
#' For each flagged message in \code{df}, collects up to \code{max_messages}
#' surrounding messages within a symmetric time window and formats them into a
#' single prompt string suitable for batch classification.
#'
#' The output contains one row per flagged message. The \code{input_text} column
#' is the primary prompt field: it places the focal message first, followed by
#' all context messages in chronological order.
#'
#' @param df A data frame of messages. Must contain the columns named by the
#'   \code{col_*} arguments. All other columns are treated as covariates and
#'   passed through to the output unchanged.
#' @param time_window_hours Numeric. Half-width of the context window in hours.
#'   Messages within \code{[focal_time - window, focal_time + window]} are
#'   eligible as context. Default \code{1}.
#' @param max_messages Integer. Maximum number of messages to include per focal
#'   event (including the focal message itself). When the window contains more
#'   candidates, the closest messages by absolute time difference are kept.
#'   Default \code{100}.
#' @param col_timestamp Character. Name of the POSIXct timestamp column.
#'   Default \code{"timestamp_datetime"}.
#' @param col_app Character. Name of the column containing the app or source
#'   label for each message. Default \code{"app_name"}.
#' @param col_text Character. Name of the column containing message text.
#'   Default \code{"text"}.
#' @param col_flag Character. Name of the binary flag column
#'   (\code{1} = focal message, \code{0} = context candidate).
#'   Default \code{"flag_bin"}.
#' @param col_id Character. Name of the participant identifier column.
#'   Default \code{"participant_id"}.
#'
#' @return A tibble with one row per flagged message and the following columns,
#'   in this order:
#'   \describe{
#'     \item{\code{<col_id>}}{Participant identifier (renamed from \code{.id}).}
#'     \item{\code{<col_timestamp>}}{Timestamp of the focal message (renamed
#'       from \code{.flagged_timestamp}).}
#'     \item{\emph{extra columns}}{Any columns in \code{df} beyond the five
#'       \code{col_*} arguments, passed through from the flagged-message row.}
#'     \item{\code{n_messages}}{Total number of messages included (focal +
#'       context).}
#'     \item{\code{n_context}}{Number of context messages (excludes focal).}
#'     \item{\code{focal_text}}{The focal message, formatted as
#'       \code{[YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM | app] text}.}
#'     \item{\code{context_text}}{All context messages in chronological order,
#'       one per line, same format as \code{focal_text}.}
#'     \item{\code{input_text}}{Ready-to-send prompt combining focal and context:
#'       \preformatted{Focal message:\n<focal_text>\n\nContext:\n<context_text>}}
#'   }
#'   Returns an empty tibble with a message if no flagged messages are found.
format_gpt_input_fast_focal = function(
    df,
    time_window_hours = 1,
    max_messages      = 100,
    col_timestamp     = "timestamp_datetime",
    col_app           = "app_name",
    col_text          = "text",
    col_flag          = "flag_bin",
    col_id            = "participant_id"
) {
  
  required_cols = c(col_timestamp, col_app, col_text, col_flag, col_id)
  missing_cols  = setdiff(required_cols, names(df))
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    stop("Missing columns in df: ", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "))
  }
  
  window_secs = time_window_hours * 3600
  
  extra_cols = setdiff(names(df), c(col_timestamp, col_app, col_text, col_flag, col_id))
  
  df = df %>%
    rename(
      .timestamp = all_of(col_timestamp),
      .app       = all_of(col_app),
      .text      = all_of(col_text),
      .flag      = all_of(col_flag),
      .id        = all_of(col_id)
    ) %>%
    mutate(.row_ts_num = as.numeric(.timestamp))
  
  flagged = df %>%
    filter(.flag == 1) %>%
    select(.flagged_timestamp = .timestamp, .id, any_of(extra_cols)) %>%
    mutate(
      flagged_ts_num = as.numeric(.flagged_timestamp),
      window_start   = flagged_ts_num - window_secs,
      window_end     = flagged_ts_num + window_secs
    )
  
  if (nrow(flagged) == 0) {
    message("No flagged messages found.")
    return(tibble())
  }
  
  dt_messages = as.data.table(df)[, .(
    .id, .row_ts_num,
    .row_ts_num_end = .row_ts_num,
    .app, .text
  )]
  
  dt_flagged = as.data.table(flagged)
  
  setkey(dt_messages, .id, .row_ts_num, .row_ts_num_end)
  setkey(dt_flagged,  .id, window_start, window_end)
  
  joined = foverlaps(
    dt_messages,
    dt_flagged,
    by.x = c(".id", ".row_ts_num", ".row_ts_num_end"),
    by.y = c(".id", "window_start", "window_end"),
    type    = "within",
    nomatch = 0
  ) %>%
    as_tibble()
  
  format_message = function(ts_num, app, text) {
    sprintf(
      "[%s | %s] %s",
      format(as.POSIXct(ts_num, origin = "1970-01-01"), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"),
      replace_na(as.character(app), "Unknown"),
      text
    )
  }
  
  result = joined %>%
    mutate(time_diff = abs(.row_ts_num - flagged_ts_num)) %>%
    group_by(.id, .flagged_timestamp) %>%
    slice_min(order_by = time_diff, n = max_messages, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    arrange(.id, .flagged_timestamp, .row_ts_num) %>%
    mutate(
      is_focal  = (.row_ts_num == flagged_ts_num),
      formatted = format_message(.row_ts_num, .app, .text)
    ) %>%
    summarise(
      n_messages      = n(),
      n_context       = sum(!is_focal),
      focal_text      = formatted[is_focal][1],   # take first if ties
      context_text    = paste(formatted[!is_focal], collapse = "\n"),
      input_text      = paste0(
        "Focal message:\n", focal_text,
        "\n\nContext:\n",   context_text
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    left_join(
      select(flagged, .id, .flagged_timestamp, any_of(extra_cols)),
      by = c(".id", ".flagged_timestamp")
    ) %>%
    rename(
      !!col_id        := .id,
      !!col_timestamp := .flagged_timestamp
    ) %>%
    relocate(
      all_of(col_id), all_of(col_timestamp), any_of(extra_cols),
      n_messages, n_context, focal_text, context_text, input_text
    )
  
  result
}


```

# MAPS
```{r}

gpt_inputs_focal = format_gpt_input_fast_focal(df=maps, time_window_hours = 1, max_messages = 100, 
                              col_timestamp = 'tm_message_start', col_app = 'id_app', col_text = 'text_clean', col_flag = 'flag_bin', col_id = 'id')

write.csv(gpt_inputs_focal, file = '../../data_stage2/fwhm_1hr_focal_maps_inputs_for_llm.csv', row.names=FALSE)
```

PREDICT
```{r}
predict = read_csv('../../data_stage2/predict_flagged_vs_maps_final_2025-08-11_with_id.csv')

predict = dplyr::select(predict, entry_id, flag_bin, filepath, text_clean, tm_message_start, tm_message_end, id_app)

gpt_inputs_focal_predict = format_gpt_input_fast_focal(df=predict, time_window_hours = 1, max_messages = 100, 
                              col_timestamp = 'tm_message_start', col_app = 'id_app', col_text = 'text_clean', col_flag = 'flag_bin', col_id = 'filepath')

write.csv(gpt_inputs_focal_predict, file = '../../data_stage2/fwhm_1hr_focal_predict_inputs_for_llm.csv', row.names=FALSE)

```
